audit_scope: Repository-visible intraday, daily, protected-holdout, and paper-account evidence across current source, Git history, and GitHub issue and pull-request discussion at the audited foundation commit; no market data was fetched and ignored runtime stores were not inspected.
universal_freshness_limit: Software can reject known overlap but cannot prove universal freshness across ignored local state, CI artifacts, discussions, other clones, provider dashboards, or human memory.

entries.evidence_rationale: The validated real daily dataset was acquired for this full envelope. This entry records acquisition separately from observed daily strategy results.

Committed training and validation documents report real daily strategy results across the 2020-2025 research spans. The envelope is conservative because individual campaigns used narrower folds within it.
